DecisionSphere

Decision intelligence

Built around Strategic Analysis AI, DecisionSphere helps people explore a decision’s objectives, constraints, risks and possible consequences before choosing a direction.

  • Structured reasoning and ripple-effect simulation
  • Probabilistic outcomes and risk analysis
  • Recommendations with implementation plans

The decision model and dashboard direction are defined. Reasoning and simulation flows are prototyped, with an interactive beta planned. People remain the decision-makers.
